external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organisation using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
external_entities.notes: Each customer company is one tenant; the text does not identify a particular company.

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.
external_entities.notes: Users authenticate with an email address and password and receive a session cookie.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice link and views the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users, which serves invoices and payment pages, applies company filters, saves invoice edits, queues PDF jobs, and fetches PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column; the database has no row-level security and the app uses one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue containing PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state how the queue is reached or protected at rest.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket containing rendered PDFs stored under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs using one service credential for all companies.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer records, payout bank details, credentials, and session cookie

data_flows.name: query tenant database
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and updates the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app saves fields from invoice edits and loads invoices from the database.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, and invoice edits

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected using the job's company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: One service credential is used for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends the payer an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link and invoice number

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: The payer opens the payment page and receives the invoice, company name, and bank details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open customer session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user at the agent's request.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: The session activity is recorded against the customer user rather than the support agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and customer records

data_flows.name: record customer action
data_flows.description: The billing app records actions performed through an impersonated customer session in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user
data_flows.notes: The activity is recorded against the customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Actions attributed to the customer user

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary separating one customer company's users and data context from other tenants.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud-platform zone containing the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents can reach the admin console.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer records, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores rendered invoice PDFs containing invoice and bank-detail information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the PDF renderer writes PDFs for invoices, and the payment page shows invoice and bank details.
